goal: Preserve the existing multi-server launch palette/profile outcomes while making every Web/Workspace host observe all server sessions through one application-scoped fleet authority and switch compound sessions in the same view.
approach: Retain typed launch profiles, server-owned argv materialization and the existing palette state contracts. Replace renderer/currentServerId session membership with one host-process FleetRuntime per configured Web or Workspace application. A shared protocol owns compound SessionRef, full immutable FleetSnapshot publication, create observation, failure/backpressure and routed-operation semantics; both hosts realize it, the SPA only projects it, and Workspace selection remains a guarded view-local transaction.

in_scope: Workspace Electron と browser SPA に共通する fleet/session-launch provider 境界
全 enabled server の project catalog 集約、server identity、partial failure、retry
server defaults と project settings override を持つ単一 command profile 設定モデル
順序付き typed parameter descriptor、default/explicit/absent semantics、schema revision
project/profile/revision/typed values を使う create-session REST contract
旧 command 設定と create payload の明示的廃止
project/session row と active context の server-qualified identity
T0-T3 検証と外部 gateway 依存の fake/FakeVsReal/contract triple
application-scoped fleet lifecycle authority and credentialed routing in both hosts
full-replacement credential-free FleetSnapshot protocol with per-server status and generation
compound SessionRef routing for create, read, mutation, terminal, transcript, and message operations
shared clients/ui fleet projection, local selection, and active-session channel switching
partial failure, stale last-known snapshot, reconnect, generation fencing, cancellation, and cleanup
migration away from currentServerId, renderer bearer/baseUrl projection, server-pinned Connection, and server-specific Workspace partitions
Web/Workspace parity, executable A/A and A/B witnesses, and external-dependency verification triples
out_of_scope: 個人化した server 並び順
任意 shell command editor または client-side shell interpolation
command parameter 間の任意スクリプト依存関係
server 間で session を移送する機能
既存 terminal lifecycle protocol の再設計
server-side launch-profile schema or argv materialization changes already owned by the existing change
runtime reload of servers.json; the accepted immutable startup snapshot remains authoritative
changing gateway-local session IDs or the daemon lifecycle wire
making serverId user-selectable as a window or process boundary
claiming the unresolved same-server POST/WS race is fixed without an executable A/A trace

requirements.rationale: Approved UX and explicit compatibility/security requirement.

requirements.statement: 明示 Confirm 後だけ、server/profile/revision/value snapshot を target server へ送信し、server が default を適用して argv を生成し、一つの server-qualified session を返す。
requirements.rationale: Approved UX and explicit compatibility/security requirement.

requirements.statement: zero-parameter profile は空 form を完了状態として作成できる。
requirements.rationale: Approved UX and explicit compatibility/security requirement.

requirements.statement: project/session row と active context は所属 server label を常時示し、display-name collision 時は stable server ID を補助表示する。
requirements.rationale: Approved UX and explicit compatibility/security requirement.

requirements.statement: fleet/project/profile の部分取得失敗は失敗 scope・理由・retry を示し、健康な scope と依然有効な selection/value/focus を保持する。
requirements.rationale: Approved UX and explicit compatibility/security requirement.

requirements.statement: server は version=2 profile request だけを受理し、旧 session.commands、default_command、POST {project,command} を fallback として扱わない。
requirements.rationale: Approved UX and explicit compatibility/security requirement.

requirements.statement: Web host と Workspace は同じ configured fleet cardinality と server-qualified session lifecycle を公開し、host kind による one-server adapter や implicit default server を持たない。
requirements.rationale: Approved UX and explicit compatibility/security requirement.

requirements.statement: Web host と Workspace main は credential/upstream address を renderer へ列挙せず、stable serverId で catalog/create/session lifecycle/operation を route する。
requirements.rationale: Approved UX and explicit compatibility/security requirement.

requirements.statement: The system shall always preserve the same stable server identity from the displayed project/session through selection, confirmation, routing, create result, and active context.
requirements.rationale: Entry and persistent-state observation require a server-qualified invariant.

requirements.statement: If a profile revision, parameter value, server identity, or routing authority is stale, malformed, unknown, or unavailable, then the system shall create no session and shall expose a typed scoped outcome.
requirements.rationale: Prevents unsafe fallback across all create boundaries.

requirements.statement: When a Web or Workspace view subscribes, the host shall immediately return one full credential-free FleetSnapshot containing every enabled server member, its typed state, and every currently known compound SessionRef.
requirements.rationale: Fleet session runtime requirement grounded in the original application-scoped authority outcome.

requirements.statement: While multiple views are open in one Workspace application, every view shall observe the same monotonically ordered fleet revisions from the one application-scoped authority; view-local selection shall not change fleet membership.
requirements.rationale: Fleet session runtime requirement grounded in the original application-scoped authority outcome.

requirements.statement: When New Session creates on any enabled server, the create outcome shall preserve serverId and shall not complete as confirmed until the same compound SessionRef is present in an authoritative fleet snapshot visible to the requesting view.
requirements.rationale: Fleet session runtime requirement grounded in the original application-scoped authority outcome.

requirements.statement: When a user selects any listed session, the current window shall switch its active SessionRef and session channel in place; the system shall not create a process, BrowserWindow, renderer partition, or fleet store because serverId changed.
requirements.rationale: Fleet session runtime requirement grounded in the original application-scoped authority outcome.

requirements.statement: All session-scoped operations shall accept a compound {serverId, sessionId} reference and shall route inside FleetProvider; raw local IDs, implicit currentServerId, and renderer-constructed server URLs are forbidden.
requirements.rationale: Fleet session runtime requirement grounded in the original application-scoped authority outcome.

requirements.statement: If one server is unavailable, reconnecting, incompatible, or stale, healthy server members shall remain current and usable; the failed member shall retain only an explicitly stale last-known snapshot and typed retry state, never silently disappear or erase another member.
requirements.rationale: Fleet session runtime requirement grounded in the original application-scoped authority outcome.

requirements.statement: Workspace main and Web host shall retain credentials and upstream addresses, reject unsafe redirects, and expose no bearer token, upstream base URL, or authorization header through the FleetProvider projection.
requirements.rationale: Fleet session runtime requirement grounded in the original application-scoped authority outcome.

requirements.statement: A current-generation hello or session-bearing view update shall atomically replace only its server member; superseded generation frames shall have no observable effect.
requirements.rationale: Fleet session runtime requirement grounded in the original application-scoped authority outcome.

requirements.statement: A successful create whose identity is not observed before the convergence bound shall return created_unconfirmed with the compound reference and observation retry, and shall never automatically repeat POST.
requirements.rationale: Fleet session runtime requirement grounded in the original application-scoped authority outcome.

requirements.statement: Web and Workspace adapters shall produce deep-equal FleetSnapshot and typed failure outcomes for the same configured fleet and upstream fixture; only HTTP/WS versus preload/IPC delivery may differ.
requirements.rationale: Fleet session runtime requirement grounded in the original application-scoped authority outcome.

requirements.statement: Static project/profile discovery shall continue to use one GET /api/session-config snapshot per server and shall join the same stable server identity used by fleet session lifecycle.
requirements.rationale: Fleet session runtime requirement grounded in the original application-scoped authority outcome.

requirements.statement: External Workspace open-session requests may provide an initial compound SessionRef, but the resulting generic fleet view shall subscribe to the application fleet and thereafter switch sessions in place.
requirements.rationale: Fleet session runtime requirement grounded in the original application-scoped authority outcome.

requirements.statement: When session rows or active context are rendered, the owning server display label shall always be visible; when labels collide, stable serverId shall also be visible and the two compound identities shall remain separately selectable.
requirements.rationale: Preserves UX UAC-009/UAC-010 and rejects local-ID/display-label ambiguity.

resolved_issues.issue: UX UAC-009/010 は session 一覧と active context の server 常時表示・表示名衝突時の stable ID を必須化する。draft は compound identity と切替だけを規定し、可視 label/collision observable を持たない。

resolved_issues.issue: FR は “before the convergence bound” とし contract の open_design_choices は空だが、post-ack 観測の開始点・期限・失効遷移がない。NFR-FLEET-002 は REST timeout であり lifecycle 観測期限を定めない。
resolved_issues.resolution: Fixed createObservationDeadline at 10s from accepted POST identity; same-or-newer observation confirms, expiry settles created_unconfirmed once, and retry never extends or repeats POST.

resolved_issues.issue: 移行 evidence の consumer 列挙に対し、実 repository には raw ID の api/workspace.ts、api/transcripts.ts、socket/subscribe.ts、WindowRegistry/control/factory が残る。変更 surface と旧契約拒否の coverage が閉じない。

resolved_issues.issue: NFR は full replacement 1回を O(N) とするだけで、W subscribers・R revisions 時の copy/queue、backpressure、slow subscriber outcome を固定しない。停滞 view で memory/I/O が収束しない実装を許す。
